events.title: Washington Triumphs at the Battle of Trenton
events.description: Hours after crossing the ice-choked Delaware River on a freezing night, George Washington's Continental Army launched a surprise attack on Hessian forces garrisoned at Trenton, New Jersey. The Hessians were soldiers hired by Britain. The Americans overwhelmed them and took many prisoners.
events.significance: The victory revived American morale and enlistments at a low point in the Revolutionary War. It gave the struggling cause fresh momentum.

events.title: The Curies Announce the Discovery of Radium
events.description: Pierre and Marie Curie announced to the French Academy of Sciences that they had found a new radioactive element. They named it radium.
events.significance: The discovery advanced the study of radioactivity and led to early medical uses of radiation, including cancer treatment. It also helped bring Marie Curie to international prominence.

events.title: The Soviet Union Is Formally Dissolved
events.description: The Supreme Soviet met for its final session and formally voted the Soviet Union out of existence. This came after the Soviet republics had declared independence one after another in the preceding months.
events.significance: The vote ended the Cold War superpower rivalry and a state that had lasted almost 70 years. Fifteen independent nations emerged from it.

events.title: Indian Ocean Earthquake and Tsunami
events.description: A magnitude 9.1 earthquake struck off the west coast of Sumatra, Indonesia. It set off giant tsunamis that struck coastlines across the Indian Ocean.
events.significance: It was one of the deadliest natural disasters in recorded history. It led to a worldwide relief effort and to major improvements in tsunami warning systems.
